summary: K-Fast Holding AB (publ), together with its subsidiary, operates as a project development company in Sweden. It operates in two segments, Property Management and Construction. The company constructs residential and commercial premises, community services properties, and industrial and logistics buildings. It is also involved in the production of prefabricated concrete frames; business development; design, production and installation of prefabricated structures; and procurement, purchasing, and construction management for the development of concept buildings. In addition, the company manages properties. Its property portfolio includes low-rise, lateral low-rise, apartment blocks, and K-Commercial concept building; and building for rental apartments, as well as commercial premises. K-Fast Holding AB (publ) was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Hässleholm, Sweden.
